svg.title: Ascendancy Systems — Meta-Gauge MG-001
svg.desc: A source-driven public-orientation instrument. A hollow gold eight-pointed star is enclosed within an oxidized-copper eight-pointed square star, surrounded by neutral calibration rings. Four qualitative fields — Constitutional North, Epistemic Fix, Continuity and Drift, and Dependency Readiness — are explicitly marked unassessed or unverified. No live measurements or scores are represented.
